slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Dynamic Programming
slides.narration: Let's solve Disk Stacking, a hard dynamic programming problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Disks [width, depth, height]; stack them so each disk is strictly smaller in all three dimensions than the one below, maximising total height.
Returns the chosen disks ordered from top (smallest) to bottom (largest).
